title: Radio-Play Booth
what: A whole scene in one request: three voices, stage directions in brackets, timing and interruptions handled by the model. The response also says who speaks when.

inputs.label: Cast
inputs.value: Mo (Brian), Pip (Jessica), Bram (designed in the Voice Loom)

inputs.label: Script
inputs.value:
Mo: [warmly] And we're back. It's twelve forty on Night Radio, and line two has been blinking for ten minutes. Bram, are you there?
Bram: [clears throat] I'm here, I'm here. Is this the radio? Am I on the radio?
Pip: [whispers] He's on the radio.
Mo: You're on the radio, Bram. What's happening at the lighthouse tonight?
Bram: Well. [sighs] The light went out. Not broken, mind you. It just... stopped. Like it wanted a nap.
Pip: [laughs] A sleepy lighthouse!
Mo: Pip, please. Bram, did you try turning it off and on again?
Bram: [offended] Young man, I have kept that light for forty years. Of course I tried that.
Pip: [excited] Ooh, ooh, I know! Play it a song! Lighthouses love songs.
Bram: [pause] ...Do they?
Mo: [laughs] Pip, cue the lullaby. Bram, hold the phone up to the lamp.
Bram: [far from the phone] It's... it's flickering. It's coming back! Would you look at that!
Pip: [cheering] Yes! The power of radio!
Mo: [softly] There you have it, night owls. Even lighthouses need a song sometimes. Goodnight, Bram.
Bram: [chuckles] Goodnight, you lot. Keep the music coming.

snippet:
d = requests.post("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-dialogue/with-timestamps",
    headers={"xi-api-key": KEY},
    json={"model_id": "eleven_v4", "inputs": [
        {"voice_id": MO, "text": "[warmly] And we're back…"},
        {"voice_id": BRAM, "text": "[clears throat] I'm here, I'm here."}]}).json()
turns = d["voice_segments"]  # voice_id, start_time_seconds, end_time_seconds
